title: Soil and Litter GitHub Issues Tracker
text:
I resolved an issue where initial soil carbon and nitrogen densities were too high by correcting unit conversions in our input data pipeline (#492, #493). I also completed discussions on data-prediction mismatch scenarios for validation (#370) and updated general project tools, which included transitioning to uv for dependency management (#384, #480), updating R tools for Zarr (#470), and adding interactive map functionality (#373). I have also finished building the soil and litter validation pipeline (#487). Next step is to get the calibration pipeline sketched, but first I need to revisit the sensitivity analysis.

Not urgent
